subject: Emotions
title: Love Languages Theory
description: A quick win: understand Love Languages Theory.

hook.text: He buys her gifts. She wants a hug. Both are showing love—but neither feels loved. Gary Chapman saw this pattern repeat.

buildup.text: Chapman's five love languages: words, acts of service, gifts, quality time, and touch. People prioritize differently.

discovery.text: Mismatched love languages cause feeling unloved despite effort. You're speaking French; they hear static.

twist.text: It lacks strong scientific support. Critics call it oversimplified. But couples find it useful as a communication tool.

climax.text: The core insight: people express and receive love differently. Assuming yours is universal causes preventable conflict.

punchline.text: Love isn't one language. It's at least five.
